name: WIND Telecom S.A.
notes:
WIND Telecom S.A. is an IP based telecommunications company.

WIND Telecom operates AS27887, an access and service provider network serving residential, enterprise and wholesale traffic in the Dominican Republic.

 AS27887 has a predominantly inbound traffic profile and support IPv4 and IPv6 unicast.The network combines public peering, private interconnections, international IP transit and local content-delivery infrastructure to improve traffic localization, latency, capacity and resilience for its subscribers and downstreams networks.

AS27887 maintains an interconnection presence at Equinix MI1/NOTA in Miami and NAP del Caribe, Dominican Republic. The network welcomes peering with content providers, cloud and application platforms, CDNs, IX participants and other networks with shared traffic.

Authorized downstream networks are registered under AS27887. AS27887 maintains an open peering policy, subject to mutually acceptable technical, routing and operational requirements.
